lane: current saved Network replay stall; source-only diagnosis
observed_by_native_lane: On https://hn.algolia.com/?q=OpenAI, signed in as admin and acting as admin's Workspace, one owned saved Network recipe Run click at approximately 2026-09-28T05:58:27Z left Run disabled and the recipe never-run for more than 113 seconds. No progress, approval, result, or visible error appeared; the resource watchdog stayed healthy and terminated resourceInvalid=false. Debug search for replay showed zero matches. This report did not run or inspect the browser itself; an unset-organization hold is ruled out by the native receipt.
source_comparison: At diagnostic base 6fa34fbb, the saved UI-to-preparation-to-approval files still carried the same lazy dispatch import as installed source d4bbe70e. D46's intervening JSON key-path repair did not alter that transport branch. This D49 candidate changes background bootstrap and the Port host after the native diagnostic run.

port_ordering_audit.finding: An immediate client post before the worker attaches its per-Port onMessage listener is not a supported root cause. background.ts calls bootstrapBackground synchronously, bootstrapBackground registers the Port host without an await, and the host attaches its onMessage listener synchronously inside onConnect. Chrome's message-passing contract explicitly permits immediate postMessage after runtime.connect and demonstrates this receiver pattern. The dispatch import starts only after the run message enters that listener; import rejection is converted to a Port error.
port_ordering_audit.distinct_silent_edge: The host returns silently when the Port name differs, sender.id differs from chrome.runtime.id, or sender.tab is present. A name mismatch is excluded by the shared PORT constant; actual installed-sidepanel sender metadata was not captured. The existing connected test supplies sender: { id: 'extension' } and dispatches onConnect synchronously before client postMessage, so it cannot distinguish a real Chrome sender-metadata rejection from a later preparation await. Another credential host expects the same id/no-tab shape and documents Chrome 153 side-panel MessageSender behavior, making the guard failure possible but unproven rather than the leading explanation.
port_ordering_audit.bounded_discriminator: On one installed replay, record only Port phases (client connected/post sent; worker onConnect; sender guard accepted or rejected with booleans for id-match and has-tab; worker run-message accepted; dispatch import settled; preparation entered), without IDs, URLs, bodies, config, or tokens. If the guard rejects, fail closed by disconnecting with a typed reason and repair the exact sender trust rule using observed Chrome metadata. If the guard accepts and preparation enters, investigate the first unresolved preparation await. Check the existing Debug log for TOOL_CONFIRM_REQUEST, not merely the word replay.

diagnostic_native_run.resource: Browser lease admitted 2026-09-28T06:23:49Z, last healthy watch 06:26:33Z, terminal 06:26:46Z resourceInvalid=false; worker DevTools stayed closed.
diagnostic_native_run.observation: After unpacked extension reload, one owned HN Search saved Network Run at 06:25:06Z showed client run posted, worker host connected, and worker host run accepted. There was no dispatch import settled, local saved run entered, or approval signal for more than 90 seconds while Run remained disabled.
diagnostic_native_run.positive_control: The same sidepanel Debug session received the independent SW desktop:availability broadcast at 06:24:47Z, proving worker relay delivery before the Run. Client and worker trace events were both visible for the Run.
diagnostic_native_run.boundary: The Port first message and sender guard succeeded. The first missing completion is import('@/lib/tools/dispatch') inside the host. In the built queue chunk this lazy import loads registry, while registry statically imports queue; no preparation dependency was reached. Why that chunk load never settles is not independently established, so the repair must remove this unnecessary lazy boundary and be verified on the same native path.

fix_candidate.mechanism: The background bootstrap already imports the canonical dispatcher. It now passes runLocalSavedPattern into registerDocumentNetworkCaptureHost, so a Port run uses the registered function directly instead of trying to load the dispatcher through the queue-to-registry lazy chunk cycle. The host still accepts only its internal Port name and same-extension non-tab sender, and still receives only saved pattern ID and assigned tab ID from the client; approval and requirements stay in the dispatcher.
fix_candidate.connected_verification: Guarded single-worker Vitest document-network-port.test.ts and document-network-saved-ui.test.tsx passed 8/8 at 2026-09-28T06:30:48Z. The latter uses actual PatternsTab, Port transport, runLocalSavedPattern, preparation, dispatcher approval, capture core and row parser, with only Chrome/Supabase boundaries doubled. Native bundled lazy-import behavior is not claimed to be reproduced by Vitest.
fix_candidate.build: Guarded WXT development build d49-fix-build-20260928 passed at 2026-09-28T06:34:03Z; full unpacked artifact tree SHA-256 c43b9717ef07a4a9043ed6bf91f5896163f42d3ec57c891e6989123da793dc44. Existing unrelated ineffective dynamic-import warnings remained.
fix_candidate.cancellation_scope: The callback injection preserves existing abort ownership. A cancellation while initial preparation is pending still waits for that dependency to settle before surfacing, but executePreparedOperation checks the aborted signal before confirmation/capture. This pre-existing UX gap is not caused or solved by the lazy-import repair and needs a separately connected cancellation fix if retained.
fix_candidate.bootstrap_coverage_limit: The tests manually register the host with the canonical dispatcher function; they do not execute full background bootstrap. Native unpacked acceptance must prove that the production bootstrap passed the callback and reached approval with DevTools closed.

confirmed_silent_gap: PatternsTab.handleRun sets runningId before awaiting runSavedPattern and clears it only in finally; runNote begins null. It offers no Cancel while running (src/features/showcase/tabs/PatternsTab.tsx:129-175, 404-434).

The Network branch dynamically imports document-network-transport and waits on openSavedPatternOperation; that Port emits no initial progress or operation deadline (src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts:536-560; src/lib/data-pattern/document-network-transport.ts:140-174).

The Port host lazy-imports dispatch and calls runLocalSavedPattern. That function awaits prepareOperation without emitting a progress stage (src/lib/data-pattern/document-network-transport.ts:114-137; src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts:1754-1780).

Preparation awaits assigned-tab lookup, fetchPatternsForDomain, chrome.scripting.executeScript document identity, SHA-256 digest, and a CDP handler import. It then awaits policy checks before requestConfirmation persists and broadcasts the privileged approval (src/lib/tools/handlers/data-patterns.ts:113-158; src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts:1672-1752, 1173-1258).
At 113 seconds, the confirmation timer's five-minute expiry would not yet have fired. No approval card alone cannot distinguish preapproval suspension from a card delivery failure.

hypotheses_disposition: The ranked list preserves the pre-instrumentation predictions. The native diagnostic run ruled out ranks 1-3 and the first-message/sender-guard portions of rank 4 for that click: the first missing transition was lazy dispatch import settlement, before runLocalSavedPattern and preparation. Post-fix native behavior remains unverified.
narrow_next_diagnostic: During one healthy guarded installed retry, keep the existing Debug log on and check for TOOL_CONFIRM_REQUEST and persistPendingConfirm failed without exporting request payloads. If no broadcast appears, inspect only the service-worker Network timing/status for the wbx_pattern read and whether the Chrome document probe callback completes; do not capture raw URLs, bodies, tokens, or pattern config. A local confirmation record would place the stall after preparation; its absence is not conclusive if storage failed, so correlate with the Debug warning. Current user-visible diagnostics cannot distinguish every preapproval await without phase progress.
causal_regression_to_write_before_fix: Use the actual PatternsTab -> runSavedPattern -> saved-operation Port host -> runLocalSavedPattern -> prepareOperation -> requestConfirmation chain. Stub only Chrome/Supabase external calls. Park the worker's fetchPatternsForDomain with a controlled promise: on baseline, the real Run row disables without a stage or Cancel, an assertion failure naming the observed defect. After a narrow repair, the row must show the preparation stage and allow Cancel; releasing the parked read after Cancel must produce no approval card, CDP attach, rows, or pattern-health write. A second connected case parks chrome.scripting.executeScript, and a settled preparation case requires the real approval card. The test must fail if Port signal forwarding, host abort, or confirmation broadcast is severed; do not revive the pending candidate's mocked-UI proof as-is.
verification: The original installed symptom was reproduced on old .114; a receipt-bound diagnostic .114 build localized the first stalled boundary with SW log positive control and DevTools closed. Guarded connected tests 8/8, compile, and development build passed after the fix. No post-fix native acceptance has been claimed; no credentials or raw captured request data were accessed.
open_action: A fresh peer must reload the receipt-bound fixed unpacked artifact with DevTools closed and independently verify one owned saved Network Run reaches approval, denial prevents attach, allowance yields rows or a specific visible remedy, and surrounding cancellation remains safe. If the native Run still stalls, return to the first missing boundary and do not classify this candidate as fixed.
